title: Top-k and Top-p Filtering
learning_objectives: Restrict sampling to the top-k tokens
Sample deterministically from a distribution with inverse-CDF
entry_point: top_k_filter(p, k); top_p_filter(p, top_p); sample(p, u)
hints: For top-p: `c = np.cumsum(p[order])`; `n_keep = int(np.searchsorted(c, top_p) + 1)` (cap at len).

failure_feedback.advice: Keep the smallest prefix whose cumulative probability is >= top_p (include the crossing token).
Floating-point sums like 0.5+0.2 may be 0.7000000000000001; use a tiny tolerance.
Return probabilities in original vocabulary order.
Return the first index whose cumulative probability is > u.
